brand.beakbound.note: Brand: stays in Latin letters, never translated.

char.pip.note: Name kept. Masculine is irrelevant in Indonesian grammar (no gender agreement); self: "aku".

char.peaches.note: Name kept; her fruit puns use "persik" (peach).

char.minty.note: Name kept; mint jokes work because Indonesian also says "mint" (teh mint).

char.orbit.note: Name kept (Indonesian "orbit" is the same word, so her moon jokes still work).

char.postmaster-bill.note: Title "Kepala Pos" (head of the post office) + name. The birds call him "Pak Bill" (Pak = Mr, the natural way an Indonesian child names an older mentor); Bill uses "kamu" with the courier.

char.courier.note: Epicene noun, fits all four birds. "Kurir Pip", "Kurir Kerajaan".

char.narrator.note: Never named on screen. Captions address the player gently, ungendered.

boss.baron-bat.note: Noble rank + "kelelawar" (bat). Short forms: "sang Baron", address "Baron". Speaks "saya"/"Anda" (ironic politeness).

boss.spitter-king.note: "Peludah" = one who spits (ludah = spit); same word as the beetles (kumbang peludah). Address "Yang Mulia"; Bill says "Raja".

boss.dusk-empress.note: "Maharani" = empress; "senja" = dusk, same word as her moths (ngengat senja). Address "Maharani"; uses royal "kami" for herself.

boss.pirate-captain.note: Short form "Kapten" (also his third-person self-reference). Gruff "kau" to the courier. Health bar (16-char budget): "KAPTEN".

boss.ember-dragon.note: "Bara" = glowing ember. Short "sang Naga", address "Naga". Grand "kau" to the courier.

guardian.king-coo.note: Adapted: "kur-kur" is the Indonesian sound for a pigeon's coo; reduplicated like a kid's nickname. Card shout "KURRR!". Third person: "Komisaris".

guardian.searchlight-gargoyle.note: "lampu sorot" = searchlight; Indonesian puts the noun first, so the card reads big "GARGOYLE" + small "LAMPU SOROT" (tell UI). Short "si Gargoyle"; self: "Sang Gargoyle menerima." UI name card (fixed layout: small line over big line): small "GARGOYLE" over big "LAMPU SOROT"; health bar "GARGOYLE".

npc.firefly-nursery.note: Nursery = daycare (penitipan anak), not a plant nursery.

npc.drum-captain.note: Band leader, not a ship captain (kapten is kept for the pirate).

npc.pyramid-caretaker.note: "Juru kunci" = traditional caretaker of a monument; short "si juru kunci".

npc.night-cabbies.note: Cargo and signer use the same words.

npc.baker.note: The Paris baker (not the volcano baker).

npc.sphinx.note: KBBI spelling (reads right for TTS). Peaches: "Om Sfinks". Signs "Tertanda: Sfinks."

npc.unit-7.note: Robot designation kept; spoken as "Unit Tujuh" if ever voiced.

npc.parrot.note: "Burung nuri" = parrot; capitalised as a name when the Captain addresses it.

title.brewer-of-the-swarm.note: "Peramu" = potion-brewer; keeps the brew and the beetle swarm.

title.keeper-of-lost-letters.note: The club job (all lost mail); echoes the epithet.

title.commissioner-of-the-curb.note: Adapted: "kaki lima" is the Indonesian curbside (street-food carts, crumbs, a bread cart is a "gerobak kaki lima"); "Komisaris" is a real police rank. Card: KOMISARIS KAKI LIMA.

title.commissioner.note: Police rank; third person: "Sang Komisaris menerima."

region.cyberpunk-city.note: Indonesianised spelling, read correctly by Indonesian TTS.

place.edge-of-the-map.note: Address on the letter: "Naga Bara, Ujung Peta".

place.sugarloaf-mountain.note: Literal translation of Pão de Açúcar ("sugar loaf"), so Pip's "not made of sugar" joke still works.

place.theatre-marquee.note: "kanopi" = the lit canopy over a theatre entrance.

level.1-5.note: "Pos Kilat" is the Indonesian name for express mail; same words as Neferhoo's "POS KILAT!".

level.1-7.note: "sarang" = the Baron's roost (also his card line).

level.2-5.note: Same words as the Skyfall rush.

level.3-1.note: Adapted: moths drawn to light; short, poetic.

level.3-2.note: Adapted: keeps wheels + rain, film-title ring ("Bernyanyi dalam Hujan").

level.3-4.note: Same words as the Gargoyle's omen headline.

level.4-5.note: The Indonesian term for a spring tide.

level.5-7.note: Adapted: "etape" = a stage of a long journey/race; "etape terakhir" = the final stretch.

cargo.1-1.en: A birthday card for the toucan twins
cargo.1-1.target: Kartu ulang tahun untuk si kembar tukan

cargo.1-2.en: Star charts for the sloth stargazer
cargo.1-2.target: Peta bintang untuk kungkang pengamat bintang

cargo.1-3.target: Lampu tidur untuk penitipan anak kunang-kunang

cargo.1-4.en: Feather boas for the carnival parade

cargo.1-5.en: A rush invitation for the drum captain

cargo.1-6.en: Cocoa beans for the temple cooks
cargo.1-6.target: Biji kakao untuk para koki kuil

cargo.1-7.en: A sundial for the dawn keeper

cargo.1-8.en: A final notice for Baron Bat
cargo.1-8.note: "Peringatan terakhir" = the formal last warning letter.

cargo.2-1.en: Laurel wreaths for the chariot racers
cargo.2-1.target: Mahkota laurel untuk para pembalap kereta kuda

cargo.2-2.en: A new chisel for the statue carver

cargo.2-3.en: Water buckets for the fire brigade
cargo.2-3.target: Ember air untuk regu pemadam kebakaran
cargo.2-3.note: Indonesian "ember" = bucket (unrelated to the Dragon, who is "Naga Bara").

cargo.2-4.en: A book of new riddles for the Sphinx

cargo.2-5.en: A telescope for the pyramid astronomer

cargo.2-6.en: A feather duster for the caretaker

cargo.2-7.en: Lamp oil for the lantern sellers
cargo.2-7.target: Minyak lampu untuk para penjual lentera

cargo.2-8.en: Water flasks for the long caravan

cargo.2-9.en: A stop-brewing order for the Spitter King
cargo.2-9.target: Perintah stop meramu untuk Raja Peludah

cargo.3-1.en: Light bulbs for the theatre marquee

cargo.3-3.en: Hot pretzels for the night-shift cabbies
cargo.3-3.target: Pretzel hangat untuk sopir taksi malam

cargo.3-4.en: A weather vane for the tallest tower
cargo.3-4.note: Weather vane = "penunjuk angin" (no vane/vain trap in Indonesian).

cargo.3-6.en: Sheet music for the accordion player

cargo.3-7.en: A midnight love letter for the baker
cargo.3-7.target: Surat cinta tengah malam untuk tukang roti

cargo.3-8.en: A wake-up call for the Dusk Empress
cargo.3-8.note: Keeps both meanings: an alarm and a warning ("alarm" is used figuratively too).

cargo.4-1.en: A new lens for the lighthouse keeper

cargo.4-2.en: Oven mitts for the volcano baker
cargo.4-2.target: Sarung tangan oven untuk tukang kue gunung berapi

cargo.4-3.en: Kite string for the beach festival

cargo.4-4.en: A reply for the island hermit

cargo.4-5.en: A tide table for the ferry crew
cargo.4-5.target: Jadwal pasang surut untuk awak kapal feri

cargo.4-6.en: Fish biscuits for the gull colony

cargo.4-7.en: Dry socks for the storm-watch sailors
cargo.4-7.target: Kaus kaki kering untuk pelaut jaga badai

cargo.4-8.en: A return-the-mail order for the Captain
cargo.4-8.target: Perintah kembalikan surat untuk sang Kapten

cargo.5-1.en: Woolly hats for the penguin choir
cargo.5-1.target: Kupluk wol untuk paduan suara penguin

cargo.5-2.en: Hot cocoa for the polar station

cargo.5-3.en: Spare fuses for the noodle bar sign
cargo.5-3.target: Sekring cadangan untuk papan nama kedai mi

cargo.5-4.en: A paper letter for a curious robot
cargo.5-4.target: Surat kertas untuk robot yang penasaran

cargo.5-5.en: Race tickets for the rooftop runners

cargo.5-8.en: The first letter ever sent to the Dragon
cargo.5-8.target: Surat pertama yang pernah dikirim untuk sang Naga

enemy.spitter-beetle.note: Short "kumbang"; their king is the Raja Peludah.

enemy.alley-pigeon.note: Pun: "gang" = alley in Indonesian and also a gang (the star-grabbing gang).

enemy.straggler.note: A pigeon that got away; tag "SEMUA TERTANGKAP!". King Coo tag (16-char budget): "SEMUA TERTANGKAP" (no "!").

enemy.brood.note: Banner: PASUKAN RAJA PELUDAH; he calls them "asisten-asistenku", "kumbang-kumbang kecilku".

enemy.swarm-bats.note: Banner: KAWANAN · Hindari kelelawar atau melesat menembusnya.

attack.embers.note: Same root as his name (Naga Bara).

attack.lamp.note: His chest lamp; "LAMPU TERBUKA", "penutup" = shutters. HUD tag (12-char budget): "LAMPU BUKA"; hints say "LAMPU TERBUKA".

attack.mail-call.note: Neferhoo's shout when he fires letters.

attack.ankh.note: Kept (the Egyptian symbol has no Indonesian name); "ankh emas".

attack.express-post.note: Indonesia's own name for express mail.

hazard.steam-geyser.note: "yang panas" / "yang lembut" = hot ones / soft ones.

hazard.tide.note: Banners: AIR NAIK · Terbang tinggi! / AIR PASANG · Tetap di atas air.

set-piece.skyfall.note: Adapted: "the sky falls"; same words as level 2-5.

set-piece.gale.note: Banners ANGIN RIBUT! / BERHASIL BERTAHAN; "sisi terbuka" = open side. Gale banner with points (20-char budget): "BERTAHAN! +{points}".

pickup.shield.note: "gelembung" = bubble; PERISAI MENYELAMATKAN! Flight callout (14-char budget): "TERSELAMATKAN!"; replay highlight "Perisai menyelamatkan".

pickup.star-power.note: Flight callout (20-char budget): "{n}× DAYA BINTANG!"; elsewhere "Kekuatan bintang".

ui.sky-club.note: Translated (a club of birds of the sky); short "klub". Postage stamp band (10-char budget): "POS LANGIT".

ui.sky-club-post.note: Also the courier's greeting at every door: "Pos Klub Langit!"

ui.passport-stamp.note: Passport ink stamp ("cap"), distinct from postage stamps ("perangko"). KARTU POS DICAP!

ui.star-marks.note: "takik" for the notch on the track.

ui.guardian.note: Always this word for a guardian.

ui.sky-reclaimed.note: UI victory card (18-char budget): "LANGIT BEBAS LAGI".

ui.bonk.note: Adapted: the Indonesian cartoon bump sound; same word as the Empress's "Duk. Duk."

ui.to-be-continued.note: Exact narrator wording: "Bersambung…" (for the UI's detection).

ui.play-games.note: Google's own Indonesian name for the service ("Google Play Game"); UI and store use it. Never spoken in the voices.

achievement.out-of-the-spotlight.note: Adapted: "sorotan" is both the searchlight beam and the limelight.

achievement.bright-lights.note: Adapted: the bright lights of the big city.

story.flame-seal.note: "segel berbentuk api" = a seal shaped like a flame.

story.warm-letter.note: "hangat" keeps both meanings (warm to the touch, kind).

story.pigeonholes.note: Pun adapted: no pigeon in the Indonesian word, so Bill's joke becomes "a post club that has never had a real carrier pigeon (merpati pos)".

story.letter-phrases.note: Adapted: Indonesian letter/postcard stock phrases; also “Lekas sembuh”, “Peluk cium”.

story.beauty-sleep.note: Indonesian has the same vanity phrase.

story.lamps.note: "lampu kota" = city lamps. No homophone risk.

story.first-letter.en: the first letter ever sent to the Dragon

story.dotted-i.en: He dotted his “i” with a tiny bat.
story.dotted-i.target: Titik huruf i-nya dia ganti kelelawar mungil.
story.dotted-i.note: Latin script: the dotted i works.

story.pharaohs-post.note: The Pharaoh's royal mail ("Tak ada kurir yang menerbangkan pos Firaun selain saya!").

story.headwear.note: Crown "mahkota"; hat "topi"; police cap "topi polisi"; diadem "diadem".

motto.every-letter-lands.note: "sampai" = arrives (the natural verb for mail). Works as a question: "Apa setiap surat benar-benar sampai?" Reused verbatim.

address.rookie.note: Bill's affectionate "newbie"; gender-neutral. Pip: "Pip si anak baru".

address.darling.note: The Gargoyle's and the Baron's "darling" (no gender).

address.sprat.note: Adapted: "teri" = tiny anchovy, also "kelas teri" (small fry).

address.skylubber.note: Adapted: no Indonesian "landlubber"; a gruff "sky kid".

address.stoneface.note: Adapted: stone face, a jovial nickname.

address.mister.note: What Indonesian children call an adult man: "Om Sfinks", "Om Neferhoo".

address.peaches-pet-names.note: Varied: manis, sayang, si imut, permen kecil, kue mangkuk, gulali, madu, cintaku, bolu manis, si mungil, cokelat kecil, kesayanganku.

address.minions.en: Cousins! / my lovelies / my little scarabs / me hearties
address.minions.note: Each boss in his own register.

phrase.baron-bat-line.en: This route is my roost now, little courier!
phrase.baron-bat-line.target: Rute ini sarang saya sekarang, kurir kecil!

phrase.spitter-king-line.en: Every letter on my road goes in the brew!
phrase.spitter-king-line.target: Setiap surat di jalanku masuk ke ramuan!

phrase.dusk-empress-line.en: Hush now. The night mail is sleeping.
phrase.dusk-empress-line.target: Ssst, tenanglah. Pos malam sedang tidur.

phrase.pirate-captain-line.en: Arr! Every mailbag on these waves be mine!
phrase.pirate-captain-line.target: Arrr! Semua kantong surat di laut ini milik Kapten!
phrase.pirate-captain-line.note: Pirate flavour: he speaks of himself as "Kapten".

phrase.ember-dragon-line.en: The sky is mine. Your letters are kindling.
phrase.ember-dragon-line.target: Langit ini milikku. Suratmu hanyalah kayu bakar.

phrase.neferhoo-line.en: Return to sender! This route has a courier.
phrase.neferhoo-line.target: Kembali ke pengirim! Rute ini sudah ada kurirnya.

phrase.king-coo-line.en: Nobody flies till the bread cart is found!
phrase.king-coo-line.target: Tak ada yang terbang sampai gerobak roti ketemu!

phrase.searchlight-gargoyle-line.en: Hold still! Nobody ever stays in the light.
phrase.searchlight-gargoyle-line.target: Diam di situ! Tak pernah ada yang mau tinggal di bawah sorotan.

phrase.return-to-sender.note: The Indonesian postal formula on returned mail (KEMBALI KE PENGIRIM). "Kembali ke... saya?" for his hurt line.

phrase.peaches-tagline.en: Rosy cheeks, curly crest, all heart.
phrase.peaches-tagline.target: Pipi merona, jambul ikal, hati penuh cinta.

phrase.minty-tagline.en: Tiny hummer. Fresh sprig. Full speed.
phrase.minty-tagline.target: Kolibri mungil. Mint segar. Kecepatan penuh.

phrase.orbit-tagline.en: A dreamy owl who flies by starlight.
phrase.orbit-tagline.target: Burung hantu pemimpi yang terbang diterangi bintang.

phrase.keep-your-beak-up.note: Adapted from "tegakkan kepala" (hold your head up).

phrase.all-screech.note: Adapted: "only his screech is big" (all bark, no bite).

phrase.no-flame-seal.en: No flame seal on this guardian.
phrase.no-flame-seal.target: Penjaga ini tak punya segel api.

phrase.mister-nice-bat.target: Tak ada lagi Kelelawar Baik Hati!

phrase.at-your-disservice.note: Adapted: inverts "siap melayani Anda" (at your service).

phrase.mind-the-gap.note: Adapted from the Jakarta commuter-train warning "perhatikan celah peron".

phrase.sticks-and-stones.note: Adapted: the proverb "the tongue has no bones" (talk is cheap) + "but my rocks are hard".

phrase.pirate-speak.note: Stage-pirate idiom: Arrr!, Ahoi!, "Berhenti di situ!" (Avast), "Demi jangkar karatan!" (Shiver me timbers), "Astaga!" (Blimey), "kau", self "Kapten".

story.mail-and-post.note: "surat" for the mail itself, "pos" for the service ("Pos Klub Langit", "pos malam").

story.salutation.note: Letter salutations: "Naga yang baik." / "Kurir yang baik,".

ui.daily-goal.note: The three daily goals: "3 MISI", "Tiga misi." Titles keep the glossary achievement.goal-* words.

ui.boss-health.note: Screen readers: "darah 120 dari 300"; numbers keep "HP" ("{hp} HP", "SISA 40 HP").

ui.dragon-heart.note: "JANTUNG ×2", "Serang jantung yang menyala". Distinct from the life "hati".

ui.defeated.note: "BARON KELELAWAR TUMBANG", health bar "TUMBANG"; same verb as PENJAGA TUMBANG.

ui.escaped.note: Rush and gale banners; "Tanpa lecet." in replay highlights.

ui.goal-done.note: Under result goals; "Belum" = Not yet; "Finis dulu" = Finish first.

ui.level-builder-short.note: Short key back to the Level Builder (12-char budget); full name "Pembuat Level".

ui.replay-title.note: Screen title (12-char budget); the thing itself stays "tayangan ulang"; "Tonton ulang" = Watch replay.

ui.seconds-unit.note: Sentences "detik"; compact labels "dtk"; tightest HUD slots keep the SI "s" ("12s").

ui.time-ago.note: 12-char budget: "{n}mnt lalu", "{n}jam lalu", "{n}hr lalu"; "baru saja" = just now.

ui.postcard-address.en: The courier / Sky Club post / Up in the sky
ui.postcard-address.target: Yth. Kurir / Pos Klub Langit / Di atas awan
ui.postcard-address.note: "Yth." = the formal Indonesian address abbreviation on envelopes.

ui.coop-keys.en: P1 · W flap · D shoot · A sprint
ui.coop-keys.target: P1: W kepak, D tembak, A lesat
ui.coop-keys.note: 40-char budget forces the root "lesat" for sprint; P2: "Atas kepak, Kanan tembak, Kiri lesat".
